hero.headline: Plan the term before students register.
hero.description: ACOPS helps academic teams organize course offerings, review projected demand, and coordinate academic planning before students register. Cohort demand projections synthesize graduation requirements across the 2019 and 2025 bylaws while departmental coordinators confirm final section offerings.

roles.title: A Unified Planning System for All Four Roles
roles.subtitle: ACOPS connects institutional administration, departmental coordination, student planning, and academic advising into one unified workflow.

admin.title: System Administration
admin.desc: Oversee degree bylaws, verify grade scales, manage data imports, and monitor departmental audit logs.

coordinator.title: Course Offering Coordination
coordinator.desc: Review cohort demand forecasts, calculate lecture and lab sections, and record binding opening decisions.

student.title: Student Degree Progression
student.desc: View upcoming course offerings, verify prerequisite eligibility, and plan remaining degree requirements.

advisor.title: Academic Advising
advisor.desc: Track advisee academic progress, identify graduation roadblocks, and inspect projected course availability.

contactModal.title: Institutional Account Provisioning
contactModal.desc: ACOPS accounts are managed and provisioned by Nile University Faculty of Computer Science administration. If you are an enrolled student or faculty member needing access, please contact IT Support or your department coordinator.
contactModal.office: Faculty of CS Administration, Building B - 2nd Floor

sec1.description: The official Academic Course Offering Planning System at Nile University. Organize upcoming semesters, map out prerequisites, and track your graduation milestones with clarity.
sec1.card1Desc: Preview expected course offerings per semester verified by academic departments.
sec1.card2Desc: Visualize multi-tier prerequisite pathways to prevent graduation roadblocks.
sec1.card3Desc: Monitor academic progress towards school core, major, and elective requirements.

sec2.lead: Simulate your upcoming semester loads, balance credit hours, and verify timetable arrangements with complete clarity.
sec2.feature1Desc: Instant alerts if two lecture or lab sections overlap.
sec2.feature2Desc: Helps departments anticipate student section requirements.
sec2.feature3Desc: Maintains steady, balanced progress across terms.

sec3.headline: See How Far You've Come.
sec3.lead: A visual progression system mapping your academic path from foundation coursework toward degree completion.

sec4.headline: Make Every Academic Decision Count.
sec4.lead: Prerequisites are essential to your graduation timeline. ACOPS reveals dependency chains, helps check eligibility, and clarifies path options early.
sec4.insightText: Demonstrates how completing core prerequisite hub courses unlocks subsequent advanced tracks.
sec4.feature1Desc: Understand requirement relationships before course planning begins.
sec4.feature2Desc: Recognize critical hub courses that lead to advanced electives.

sec5.description: Sign in with your official Nile University account to access your course catalog, simulate upcoming terms, and plan your path to graduation.
